model: ANYterrain Stabilized w/ Dual Rear Suspension 4 Wheel Electric
description:
Introducing the ANYterrain Stabilized 4-Wheel Electric Bike, a revolutionary ride designed to conquer every landscape with unmatched stability and control. This advanced electric bike is engineered for adventure, featuring a robust four-wheel design that enhances balance and traction on various terrains, from smooth city streets to rugged off-road trails. This 4 wheel electric bike features a unique front end that allows the front wheels to tilt and lean. This allows the ANYterrain to corner sharply while staying balanced. All four tires are four inches wide, the rear are 20" diameter and the front are 16" diameter. The extra wide tires keep a lot of rubber on the road, ensuring the ANYterrain stays firmly planted on the ground. This 4 Wheel EBike features a 750 watt rear mounted motor and a 20ah battery with Samsung Cells. Riders can reach speeds of up to 20mph and a range of up to 50 miles on a single charge. The range will vary based up on the weight of the rider, how the electric is used and also the terrain you are riding on. The ANYterrain weighs 120lbs, so it is not light but it keeps the ebike stable to the ground. The front and rear brakes are hydraulic stopping this ebike quick and easy. There is a disc on each wheel to ensure the brakes stop this 4 wheel bike safely. If you have cargo, this ebike is a great option. You've got a huge basket in the rear and a front basket to bring all of your belongings on trips. You've also got an electric horn and turn signals. Both can be activated easily on the handlebars. Use your turn signals when in the bike lane or on the streets to notify others the direction you are turning. Take the ANYterrain 4 wheel electric bike on any trail or in any bike lane. If you want something easy to balance, fun to ride and has a powerful motor, the ANYterrain is for you.

Powerful 750 watt rear mounted motor

20ah Battery w/ Samsung Cells

Hydraulic Disc Brakes in the Front and Rear

Tilting Front Steering for safe balancing and sharp cornering

Rear turn signals for safe turning

Reverse feature for easy maneuvering
